properties.summary: Buildings finished since 2022 are drawn on their OpenStreetMap footprints, at official heights where the City's records give them (the Related towers at about 214 and 217 ft, the Greystar buildings at about 85 ft) and otherwise estimated from official story counts at 10.2 ft a story (illustrative); SummerHill's 2333 Calle del Mundo has no official height and is outlined only. Every other parcel in the plan (26 acres) is an illustrative height envelope: the plan allows towers up to 220 ft (or the FAA limit, if lower) over podiums up to 85 ft. These are limits, not designs. Streets are outside the parcels; the plan's undecided park sites are not cut out.
properties.note: Built buildings are drawn on their real footprints; every other parcel shows the plan's height limits, not a design.

georeference.method: none: City of Santa Clara GIS parcels and OpenStreetMap footprints, no traced figure

properties.license: Parcels: City of Santa Clara open data (map.santaclaraca.gov). Footprints: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps.

properties.note: 5123 Calle del Sol Parcel 29: approved July 2019 for a 20-story building with 192 homes (Notice of Determination); not built. Drawn to the plan's limits: towers up to 220 ft (or the FAA limit, if lower) over podiums up to 85 ft. Buildings over about 175 ft need an FAA no-hazard determination.
